name: Chip
summary: A compact pill you press (a filter, toggled with selected) or remove (a picked value).
useWhen: A row of filters that each turn on and off
Values the user picked that can be removed one by one: tags, recipients, filters in use
A quick attribute choice in a toolbar
avoidWhen: A label that cannot be pressed or removed
One choice out of several where only one may be on
The main action of a view

children.description: The visible label, one to three words.

size.description: From size.control: 24, 28 and 32 px at default density. Never under 24 by 24.

start.description: Leading content, drawn in the icon part: a system icon name or node, hidden from assistive tech. A selected chip shows check in its place. Named start by rule 6 of anatomy.md; the part keeps the order's name icon.

selected.description: Pressable form only. Set (true or false) makes the chip a toggle: aria-pressed, data-selected, the solid fill of its tone and a check. Undefined is a plain action.

onClick.description: Pressable form: called on click, Enter and Space.

onRemove.description: Makes the chip removable: the root becomes a span with a remove button. Called on the remove button's click, Delete and Backspace. Move focus after removing.

removeLabel.description: The name of the remove button. Default Remove followed by the label when it is text, or إزالة under an Arabic Theme. Name what is removed: Remove filter Arabic.

disabled.description: aria-disabled and data-disabled on the pressable root or on the remove button. Stays focusable.

a11y.role: button (the pressable root, aria-pressed when selected is set). The removable form is a span with text and a remove button.
a11y.focus: The pressable chip is one tab stop; the removable chip's remove button is one tab stop. A 2px ring on keyboard focus. Both stay focusable when disabled.

keys.Enter: Presses the chip, or the remove button
keys.Space: Presses the chip, or the remove button
keys.Delete: On the remove button: removes the chip
keys.Backspace: On the remove button: removes the chip
keys.Tab: Moves to the next chip or remove button

a11y.announce: The label as the button name, with pressed or not pressed when selected is set. The remove button is named by removeLabel.
notes: A chip is pressable or removable, never both, so a button never sits inside a button.
The chip and its remove button are two targets of at least 24 by 24 px (WCAG 2.5.8): the remove button is an xs CloseButton. An xs removable chip stays 24px tall, in line with a pressable one.
Selected is shown by fill and a check icon, not by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
In forced colors a selected chip is the system Highlight fill with HighlightText; it opts out of forcing so the text backplate does not hide the label.
After a removal, move focus to the next chip's remove button, else the previous one, else a nearby control; the demo shows it (WCAG 2.4.3).

en.label: A noun or a short noun phrase in sentence case: Images, Shared with me.
en.removeLabel: Remove plus what it is: Remove filter Arabic.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: الصور، مشاركة معي.
ar.removeLabel: إزالة plus what it is: إزالة فلتر العربية.

react.note: Motion: none of its own today; colors swap at once. A chip list may use fade-rise for added chips from the catalog (1.11). The remove part is a CloseButton root carrying data-part remove.

styles.studio: A semibold pill on the overlay steps; selected is the inverted fill with a check.
styles.desk: The same; the selected accent chip is yellow with ink text and the doubled focus ring.
styles.neutral: Planned: follows the tokens, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: A Chip with no onClick and no onRemove
A remove button named only Remove
Selected shown by a color change alone
mistakes.right: selected, which fills the chip and adds a check

mistakes.wrong: Focus lost to the page after a chip is removed
mistakes.right: Move focus to the next chip's remove button
